gate_bias_context.rule: Switching-energy (Eon/Eoff/Etot) and charge rows are measured at -5/+18 V and are SPECIFIC to that bias and to VDS=400/520 V. They are NOT directly applicable to the 0/+15 V proposal and are labeled SOURCE_CONDITION_MISMATCH. They must not be silently transferred into a 0/+15 V energy or gate-loss number.

parameters.name: qg_c
parameters.condition: VGS = -5/18 V, VDS = 520 V, ID = 20 A
parameters.page_figure: p2 Table 2 (CHARGES, CAPACITANCES & GATE RESISTANCE), QG(TOT) row; repeated p1 Features
parameters.applicability_reason: Measured over a -5/+18 V (33 V) gate swing at VDS=520 V. The proposed 0/+15 V drive is a 15 V swing, so total gate charge required will be lower; the value is recorded but not directly transferable.

parameters.name: qgd_c
parameters.condition: VGS = -5/18 V, VDS = 520 V, ID = 20 A
parameters.applicability_reason: Same -5/+18 V, VDS=520 V test point as QG(TOT). Gate-drain charge is voltage-swing dependent; not directly applicable at 0/+15 V.

parameters.name: plateau_v
parameters.page_figure: No numeric value published. Only p5 Figure 7 (Gate-to-Source Voltage vs Total Charge) shows a plateau region.
parameters.source_ref: NTH4L060N065SC1-Rev3-2023-01.pdf p2 Table 2 (absent); p5 Figure 7 (curve only)
parameters.applicability_reason: No Miller plateau voltage is stated as a parameter. Reading one off Figure 7 would require digitization/fitting, which this task forbids. Left null.

parameters.name: intrinsic_gate_r_ohm
parameters.condition: f = 1 MHz (gate resistance; no drain bias or current stated)
parameters.page_figure: p2 Table 2 (CHARGES, CAPACITANCES & GATE RESISTANCE), Gate-Resistance RG row
parameters.applicability_reason: Internal gate resistance is a device geometry/process property; no published dependence on gate bias or drain current. Used as-is.

parameters.name: eoss_j
parameters.page_figure: No Eoss parameter published. p1 Features gives Coss = 133 pF; p5 Figure 8 gives Coss vs VDS.
parameters.source_ref: NTH4L060N065SC1-Rev3-2023-01.pdf p1 (Coss=133 pF); p5 Figure 8 (Coss vs VDS curve)
parameters.applicability_reason: The datasheet publishes Coss at VDS=325 V and a Coss-vs-VDS curve but no stored-energy (Eoss) value, and no Eoss test condition. Computing Eoss would require digitizing Figure 8 and integrating over the actual bus voltage (400 V), which is an inference/fit. Left null.

parameters.name: rds_max_ohm
parameters.condition: VGS = 18 V, ID = 20 A, TJ = 25 C
parameters.page_figure: p2 Table 2 (ON CHARACTERISTICS), RDS(on) VGS=18 V / TJ=25 C row (Max column = 70); headline p1
parameters.source_ref: NTH4L060N065SC1-Rev3-2023-01.pdf p2 Table 2; p1 headline RDS(ON) MAX 70 mohm @ 18 V
parameters.applicability_reason: The only guaranteed RDS(on) maximum is specified at VGS=18 V, ID=20 A, TJ=25 C. At the proposed VGS=15 V the datasheet gives only a 60 mohm TYPICAL and no maximum, and no guaranteed hot (100/125 C) point exists. The 70 mohm max is recorded with its true condition.

parameters.name: eon_j
parameters.condition: VGS = -5/18 V, VDS = 400 V, ID = 20 A, RG = 2.2 ohm, inductive load, TJ = 25 C
parameters.applicability_reason: Recorded per task instruction. Measured at a -5/+18 V bipolar gate swing (33 V) and one event current (20 A). Not a 0/+15 V number and not a phase-distributed PFC switching loss.

parameters.name: eoff_j
parameters.condition: VGS = -5/18 V, VDS = 400 V, ID = 20 A, RG = 2.2 ohm, inductive load, TJ = 25 C
parameters.applicability_reason: Same mismatch as EON. Not transferable to 0/+15 V.

parameters.condition: VGS = -5/18 V, VDS = 400 V, ID = 20 A, RG = 2.2 ohm, inductive load, TJ = 25 C
parameters.applicability_reason: EON + EOFF as published; same bias mismatch. Not to be multiplied by a PFC line-cycle frequency as a line-average loss without a phase-current model.

switching_energies_note: EON=45 uJ, EOFF=18 uJ, Etot=63 uJ are the only published switching energies. Their test point is VGS=-5/+18 V, VDS=400 V, ID=20 A, RG=2.2 ohm, inductive load, TJ=25 C (p2 Table 2, SWITCHING CHARACTERISTICS). This is a SOURCE_CONDITION_MISMATCH with the proposed 0/+15 V, phase-varying PFC commutation. They are recorded, NOT transferred.
source_notes: No source retrieval failed. The retained PDF exists under two paths and both copies are byte-identical.

The dispatch packet's `contract_path_and_sha256` names zapote/power-entry/loss-budget/campaign/contract-C1.json, but the file actually resides at zapote/power-entry/loss-budget/campaign/runs/contract-C1.json. The declared SHA-256 (3bf1125f...) matches the resolved file exactly, so this is a path-label discrepancy only, not an integrity failure.

pdftotext drops the ohm/micro glyphs during extraction, so unit cells such as 'm' (mohm), the Gate-Resistance unit column, and switching-loss 'J' (uJ) required careful reading against the table header. No numeric value was reconstructed from a dropped glyph; units were taken from the standard symbol (RG -> ohm, EON/EOFF/Etot -> J / uJ).
